name: fugue
description: Compose algorithmic and generative music with Claude.
long_description:
Fugue is a system for composing algorithmic and generative music. This extension registers the Fugue MCP server so Claude can build inventions — declarative documents describing a module graph — and play them live, adjusting scales, rhythms, and synthesis parameters in real time.

The extension bundles the `fugue-mcp` adapter alongside the `fugue` CLI, which provides the shared `fugue serve` audio daemon. The adapter connects to an already-running daemon when one is present and spawns it otherwise, so a Fugue session started in the terminal and one driven from Claude land on the same live invention.
